purpose: Teach: 大尉/同書/号証/線形/密集/細心/デモンストレーション/もとづく
target_vocab: デモンストレーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業前、海軍の大尉でいらした
lines.en: Before founding the company, your father was a naval captain.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective opening. Gentle authority in the voice — not lecturing, remembering. Measured pace, each phrase given its weight. A small pause before the title, honoring it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは同書を経営の指針にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father used that book as his management philosophy.
lines.style: Steady acceptance, almost solemn. Clear enunciation on 「指針」 — not performing, simply confirming what was true. Quiet commitment underneath, like an oath being renewed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、契約紛争で号証管理を徹底された
lines.en: And in contract disputes, he was meticulous about evidence management.
lines.style: Voice softens with remembrance. Slow cadence, lingering slightly on 「徹底」 — not admiring from a distance, reliving a principle. Breath of weight at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは売上の線形成長を信じた
lines.en: Yes. He believed in steady, linear growth in sales.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Voice even and grounded. On 「線形成長」 a slight firmness — not doubt, conviction. Nods slightly as if understanding something again for the first time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、密集した工場でも事故ゼロを保たれた
lines.en: Even in a densely packed factory, he maintained zero accidents.
lines.style: Voice gains quiet intensity. Slight lean forward in the vocal delivery. 「事故ゼロ」 held with pride and protection — this was discipline earned. Small exhale after, like relief at remembering it still stands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは細心の経営判断をされた
lines.en: Yes. He made careful, meticulous management decisions.
lines.style: Deeper now, almost solemn. Each word deliberate. A slight catch of emotion on 「細心」 — not breaking, but the weight of inheritance audible. Steady through to the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品デモンストレーションを自ら披露された
lines.en: He demonstrated the products himself, in person.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly — a moment of personal memory. Warm underneath the wistfulness. Soft emphasis on 「自ら披露」 — not bragging, marveling at the man's presence. Trailing fondness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事実にもとづく経営を貫かれた
lines.en: Yes. He remained true to fact-based management, all his life.
lines.style: Final confirmation, carrying the weight of legacy. Voice settles into depth and quiet power. On 「貫かれた」 — absolute, unwavering. A slow close, like closing a door gently but firmly. This is the inheritance.
